title: reMaestro plugin browse catalogue
description: Generated. One document listing every plugin, at index/catalog.json. Read by the console's browse and search only — no install or update path may depend on it, which is what keeps the per-plugin documents small.

featured.description: The shop window, and it is in this document and in no other. It is absent when nothing is featured rather than present and empty, so a console never has to tell those apart. THIS IS EDITORIAL AND IS NOT A TIER: it says we put something in front of you, never that anybody checked it, and a console that renders it anywhere near a publisher chip has blurred the one distinction the tiers exist to make. It carries ids and an order and no tier, no badge and no evidence — there is nothing here to be evidence of. Deliberately absent from index-plugin.schema.json: the per-plugin document is what a hub installs from, and featuring must never be on that path.

spotlight.description: One plugin with a sentence a maintainer wrote about it, or absent. Never one of the ids in 'plugins' below — the generator refuses the overlap rather than resolving it.

plugins.description: Plugin ids, in the order somebody chose. Every one of them has a row in 'plugins' at the root of this document — the generator drops any that does not, because a window pointing at something this very document does not carry is a 404 against our own feed.

tier.description: Enough to draw a chip and to filter on, and no more: what was checked and when lives in the per-plugin document, which is the one somebody is reading when they are about to install. Says who a publisher is; never that a plugin is safe.

document.description: Path of the per-plugin document, relative to the feed base. The console follows this rather than composing a path, so the layout can change without a hub release.
